3) Submission path: please upload a signed claim form (I’ve attached our Excel template) and the cohort roster (CSV). For invoicing options, we accept a partner invoice routed to billing@redwood.ai; include RBW-BRIGHT-124 on the invoice.
4) Legal checklist: minimums are signed claim form, partner PO (if needed), and W-9 for US entities. For accelerator cohorts we also require a short sponsor acknowledgement signed by your legal team.

I attached the promo_claim_form.xlsx to this message. Next: Ben, can you confirm the legal contact and whether finance needs any additional paperwork for crediting vs issuing a vendor credit?
